text:
**What you're into**

Two passes. First you sort the broad areas — I only drill into the ones you rank, and the follow-ups only fire for what you actually chose.

prompt: Sort the broad areas — where does each one sit with you?
hint: Submission / Humiliation — power exchange, status, deference. Feminization / Emasculation — presentation, body, identity. Mindset / Conditioning — reshaping how you think. Integration / Exposure — real-life reach. Sexual / Masturbation — arousal reorientation, orgasm control. "Like with rejection" means you want it but you struggle with wanting it — tell me which, I'll handle both.

prompt: Now the pieces — where is each one with you today?
hint: The top three rungs are real-world territory — doing it, have done it, ready to. Fantasy stays in your head for now.
choices: Physical protocols — posture and movement rules
Beta / inferior — ranking below, comparative inadequacy

prompt: Your feminization, piece by piece — where does each piece stand?
hint: Doing, done once, ready to — those count as real-world territory. Fantasy stays in your head, for now.

prompt: Now the inside — where does each of these actually stand?
hint: Top three rungs mean it has left your head and touched the real world — Fantasy stays between your ears for now.

prompt: Now the reach into your life — where does each one stand?
hint: Top three rungs mean it already reaches your life, or soon could. Fantasy stays in your head for now.

prompt: Last set — the sexual layer. Where does each one sit?
hint: Top three rungs are things your body has done or is ready to do. Fantasy stays in your head for now — I'll know which ones to move.

text:
**A few follow-ups**

These only appear for what you placed at Fantasy or above — or ranked in what actually pulls you. A last pass over what you actually chose.

prompt: Chastity — do you have a cage?
hint: A cage changes what obedience costs and what I can enforce — I plan around what you own.

prompt: How long have you worn it — your longest stretch locked?
hint: Your longest stretch tells me what your body already tolerates — and what it could be trained to.
choices: A few hours to a day

prompt: How much denial have you actually done?
hint: Your baseline decides where the work starts — I don't train a novice and a veteran the same way.
choices: Long denial is routine for me

prompt: Where are you with anal play?
hint: I start from where your body actually is, not where the fantasy puts it.
choices: Regular — I know what my prostate can do

prompt: Reconditioning — what's the end state you actually want?
hint: I program toward a target — mark every target that's real for you.
choices: Hands-free — climax from nothing but the right input
Reoriented wants — what turns me on itself changes

prompt: Where is your voice?
hint: Voice work is slow and unforgiving of skips — I pace it to what you've already put in.

prompt: What shape is your voice in — any training behind it, and do you know your comfortable pitch range?
hint: The app can analyze your voice, so don't perform for me here — I'll measure it myself soon enough.

prompt: Hormones — where does fantasy end and reality begin for you?
choices: Fantasy only — I never want the real thing

prompt: Do you have a femme name — one that's already yours, or one you want to grow into?
hint: Names do work. I'll use it however you tell me — in session only, everywhere, or nowhere yet.

prompt: What does your wardrobe actually hold?
hint: Tasks get built around what you own — or around acquiring it.
choices: Nothing yet — I start from zero
Enough to dress fully, head to toe

prompt: Who knows about this side of you?
hint: This sets how loud anything of yours can ever be — exposure games included.

any.includes: Being seen feminine — mirrors, photos, others recognizing me as a girl

choices: One or two people I trust
Friends or a community know me this way

prompt: How much hypno and conditioning have you actually taken in?
hint: What's already installed shapes what I build on — and what I build around.
choices: Listened to hypno — no real effects
Listened — and I've felt it work on me

prompt: Tell me about the triggers you already carry — the words or phrases, what they do to you, how they got in.
hint: The word, the effect, the source — whatever you remember. They're live, and I'd rather know than find out.

prompt: What has hypno actually changed in you — thoughts, moods, habits?
hint: The honest before-and-after — welcome or not.

any.equals: Listened — and I've felt it work on me

prompt: And what do you actually respond to — sort these by how each one lands on you.
hint: Top tier is what takes you deepest, bottom tier is what kicks you out. Voices, induction styles, session shapes — anything I missed goes in the note: a favorite file, a voice, a phrase that gets you.
choices: Soft, soothing voice — gentle, coaxing, safe
Commanding voice — authority that doesn't ask twice
Spirals & fixation — eyes locked while it sinks in
Mantras & repetition — lines drilled until they're mine
Slow, progressive induction — sinking one layer at a time
Fast, insistent pacing — momentum that won't let up
Direct commands — told exactly what I am, what to do
Permissive & conversational — invited rather than ordered
Long sessions — losing track of time entirely
Short loops — brief, replayable, cutting grooves
Layers of sound — echoes, whispers under whispers, binaurals

any.equals: Listened — and I've felt it work on me

prompt: Has hypno ever misfired on you — dissociation, rejection, anything that scared you off?
hint: Dissociation — losing the thread of who or where you are. Rejection — sudden revulsion or panic that rips you out. Both are common, neither disqualifies you — but I pace around what's true.
choices: Dissociation — I lost the thread of who or where I was
Rejection — sudden revulsion or panic, had to rip the headphones off
Emotional hangover — heavy, low, or raw for hours after
Fear during — feeling watched, trapped, or not in control
Aftereffects that bled into my day — words sticking, moods shifting

prompt: Tell me about it — what it felt like, how long it stayed, what brought you back.
hint: Whatever you remember is enough. This maps your edges before I ever test one.

any.includes: Dissociation — I lost the thread of who or where I was
Rejection — sudden revulsion or panic, had to rip the headphones off
Emotional hangover — heavy, low, or raw for hours after
Fear during — feeling watched, trapped, or not in control
Aftereffects that bled into my day — words sticking, moods shifting

prompt: When it comes to triggers — what do you want built into you?
hint: Words that reach past the session change what you are between chats — decide with that in mind.
choices: Nothing new — keep all of it inside sessions
New ones — but only what I approve first
New ones — you choose, I don't need to vet them
New ones — and some I should never find out about

prompt: The deeper cut — what of you is actually on the table to rewrite?
hint: Top tier means I may change it for real, not just talk about it. "Fantasy only" keeps it in the words; "Leave it alone" is a wall I don't touch.
tiers: Yes — with my OK each time
Fantasy only — say it, never make it real
choices: My inner monologue — how I talk to myself
My tastes — what I find hot
My name and how I'm addressed
My sense of self — who I understand me to be
My past — how I remember who I was
My habits — the small ways I move through a day

any.includes: Having my mind rewritten — thoughts, self-talk, name, sense of self altered or overwritten

prompt: How deep is deep enough — how lost in it do you want to get?
hint: Depth is a dial we turn together — this sets where it starts, and where I stop pushing it.

showIf.includes: Escaping into the fantasy — sinking deep enough to lose ordinary self-awareness

choices: Surface — aware the whole time, savoring it
Deep — trance, but I remember everything
Deeper — gaps are fine, missing minutes is the point
Lost — as gone as I can get and still come back

prompt: Where may humiliation actually reach?
hint: Reach is about where it can live, not how cruel it gets — that's tuned separately.

any.includes: Being degraded and made lesser — humiliation, embarrassment, the heat of being brought down

choices: Words in chat — private, between us
In audio — said out loud, straight into my ears
In tasks — written down, measured, on the record
Semi-public — out where a stranger could stumble on it

prompt: When you resist — the squirming, the 'no, not that' — what should I do with it?
hint: This is about the erotic kind of no. Your hard limits and your safeword still override everything here.

showIf.includes: Being pushed past my resistance — manipulated, forced, taken further than I'd go alone

choices: Back off instantly — resistance means stop
Test it — push gently, stop if it hardens
Work it — treat it as part of the game and push through
Feed on it — the resisting is the point; make me watch myself lose

prompt: Real encounters — fantasy fuel, or something you want in the flesh?
hint: Fantasy and flesh train differently — I need to know which one I'm feeding.
choices: Fantasy only — it stays in my head
I want this in real life

prompt: If I had you post — how exposed could you get, at most?
hint: That's a ceiling I work under, not a target I chase — you set the maximum.
choices: Anonymous — never face or anything identifying

prompt: And how close are you to actually posting?
hint: How much push you need — or how little — decides how I handle you.
choices: Ready — I just need the push
Want to want it — corrupt me into it

prompt: What would have to happen — or never happen — for posting to feel okay to you?
hint: Hard limits and enablers alike — better stated now than discovered later.
